narrative.overview:
A small instrument you pull out, note something with, and later look back through. Most of the time it is for noting: a stock Material 3 tool, calm and plain, built from quiet tonal surfaces so the thing being saved or read is the loudest object on screen. It is used in passing moments, so each screen offers one primary action and keeps controls and metadata out of the way until asked.

Looking back is where the observatory appears. The Brain tab draws the collection as a globe that can be turned: indigo wire on cool paper by day, on a deep sky by night, with clusters as lit bodies and the things in them in orbit. That is the one place expression is spent.

The app is deliberately not AI, and nothing in it borrows AI visual language such as sparkles. It also rejects nested folders, productivity-app gamification and a cluttered detail page.
keyCharacteristics: Calm, plain Material 3 on every working screen.
Observatory Indigo for action and selection; Instrument Brass only for what is still waiting.
One family, Figtree, mapped to Material type roles.

rules.name: The Brass Means Waiting Rule
rules.body: Instrument Brass marks only things still waiting on the user. Never use it for decoration, emphasis or completed items. (Cluster hues are a separate set, even where one matches the brass value.)

rules.name: The Hues Are Not Text Rule
rules.body: Cluster colours identify; they never colour text.

rules.name: The Roles Only Rule
rules.body: Screens take colour from Material roles, so light and dark resolve themselves. No raw hex in screen code.

rules.name: The Role Rule
rules.body: Text maps to a Material type role. Use sp so it follows the system font size.

rules.name: The Flat Instrument Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces by tone or a hairline. Never add a drop shadow.

dos: **Do** give each screen one primary action.
**Do** show information first and put controls and metadata on request.
**Do** write short, plain, sentence-case copy, with controls that name their action.
**Do** use stock Material 3 components, themed through roles, type and shape.
**Do** keep expression on the Brain tab.
**Do** offer a list-based way to do anything the globe does.
donts: **Don't** use AI sparkle iconography or present anything as AI.
**Don't** clutter the detail screen; it holds the item and at most one button.
**Don't** use Instrument Brass for anything that is not waiting on the user.
